title: ÆTHER: Overtake F1 extended (2:30, Carnatic hype sections)
story: Race day. A young driver starts last on the grid and charges through the field lap after lap to take the chequered flag in front of a roaring crowd.

brief.notes: Jithesh 3 Nov 07:56: everything lacks 'that hype or high note where it grabs attention', 'use Carnatic music knowledge', and 'Overtake make it 2-3 min'. Keeps v3 take 2 (the one delivered) 0-50 s exactly via inpainting, then adds 100 s of new laps built on Carnatic devices as the hype moments: korvai build (phrase x3 landing on the downbeat slam), a female Carnatic voice holding the high upper-octave Sa with gamakam over the drop, tisram (triplet) gear-shift, a mridangam vs thavil duel breakdown, final drop and a korvai ending. Shankarabharanam = the C major the take already sits in, so it stays in key.

positive_styles: a bright, euphoric, high-energy motor-racing film anthem at 152 BPM, same sound, same tempo and same key as the reference: pulsing synth arpeggios, driving palm-muted electric guitar into power chords, huge punchy modern drums, soaring strings and heroic brass
the melody is Carnatic raga Shankarabharanam in C (C D E F G A B), phrased like a Carnatic singer: slides into notes, fast ornaments (gamakam), quick sangathi variations of the hook
real instruments played by real musicians, close and natural: Carnatic violin, mridangam, thavil
loud, wide, bright modern mix, positive and triumphant
THE BUILD: the whole band plays one short rhythmic phrase three times in a row (a Carnatic korvai), each time louder and faster, the drums rolling, landing together on a huge slam on the downbeat
